package.name: opponent_detector
package.description: LiDAR-only dynamic opponent detection and tracking (Frenet output) for F1TENTH racing. Clusters the 2D LiDAR scan, filters static structure with the known map and track boundaries, projects clusters into the raceline Frenet frame, and identifies the moving opponent by its relative velocity (constant-velocity Kalman tracking). Publishes f110_msgs ObstacleArray and ProjOppTraj for the overtaking pipeline.
